title: Entity stubs missing fields required by blackbox spec discriminator patterns
description: When a blackbox spec describes a dual-purpose entity (e.g., audit trail for both HTTP requests AND pipeline events), bootstrap creates entity stubs matching only one usage pattern. The AuditTrail entity was created with HTTP-centric fields only, missing the event_category discriminator and pipeline-specific fields (process_name, host, description) explicitly required by the spec.
root_cause: Phase 2.1 (Derive Required Artifacts) scans blackbox specs for entity references but does not detect discriminator patterns or dual-purpose designs. The entity field extraction focuses on explicit field listings but misses resolved schema decisions that add structural columns.
recommendation: In Phase 2.1 entity field extraction, add a sub-step: for each entity, scan ALL blackbox specs that reference it and build a UNION of required fields across all usage contexts. Flag fields with discriminator semantics (event_category, type columns) as mandatory. Cross-reference 'Resolved Schema Decisions' sections in blackbox specs for additional required columns.
bootstrap_context: Phase 1, Python 3.13 + FastAPI + SQLAlchemy, greenfield repo
